fields.name: locale
fields.title: Locale
fields.description: BCP 47 locale tag used for number/date formatting (e.g. nb-NO, en-US).

fields.name: tabs
fields.title: Tabs
fields.description: Ordered list of worksheet tabs. Each tab carries its own grid layout metadata and a sparse cell map.

fields.name: frozen_rows
fields.title: Frozen rows
fields.description: Number of rows frozen at the top of the viewport (0 = none).

fields.name: frozen_cols
fields.title: Frozen columns
fields.description: Number of columns frozen at the left of the viewport (0 = none).

fields.name: col_widths
fields.title: Column widths
fields.description: Sparse map of column index (1-based, as string key) to width in pixels.

fields.name: row_heights
fields.title: Row heights
fields.description: Sparse map of row index (1-based, as string key) to height in pixels.

fields.name: merges
fields.title: Merged ranges
fields.description: List of merged cell ranges in A1 notation (e.g. ["A1:B2"]). The merged value lives at the range's top-left anchor cell.

fields.name: cells
fields.title: Cells
fields.description: Sparse map of cell address (e.g. "A1") to cell descriptor: {v (value), f (formula), t (type: s|n|b|e|date|datetime), fmt (format hint: fixed|percent|currency|thousands|date|datetime), stale (formula cache stale flag), s (style: {b, i, bg, al})}.

fields.name: cond_formats
fields.title: Conditional formats
fields.description: Ordered list of conditional-formatting rules, each %{id, range, when:{op, value[, value2]}, style:{bg[, b][, i]}}. `range` is a single A1 cell ("B2") or an A1:B2 range (any corner order); `when.op` is one of gt|lt|eq|between|contains (gt/lt: numeric value; between: numeric value+value2 inclusive; eq: number|non-empty string|boolean; contains: non-empty string); `style.bg` is a required #rrggbb color, `b`/`i` optional literal true. Single-rule-per-range: two rules with the same normalized range are rejected at the gate (CF-D4); ids must be unique per tab; at most 200 rules per tab. Evaluated server-side into the snapshot styles map (CF-D1).
